scores.label: A
scores.note: 0s: 2 'so dense', 4 'so thick' and 6 'so heavy' give 'so so ...' in place, and 4 also repeats 'thick'. 5 'extremely thick' repeats 'thick' and gives the awkward 'so extremely thick'. 9 'so extremely heavy' is awkward. 'very dense' and 'very heavy' give a usable but wordy 'so very ...'. Only 'dense' is strong, and most options are variants of the same three words.
